about: Piracetam (no Australian brand exists, so the ingredient name is used) is supplied seven times from September 2025 to March 2026 to a 72-year-old.
Piracetam 1200 mg twice a day is supplied three times from December 2025 to February 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Donepezil, a proven medicine for Alzheimer-type dementia that is not on the list, is supplied monthly. Piracetam does not appear.
